rubric_notes: Complete: four families with correct SCCS/SUNIDs under superfamily a.22.1 (47113), fold a.22 (47112), class a (46456) in SCOPe 2.08; superfamily supports probable common ancestry of histone-fold domains while family separation indicates more remote relationship; explicit non-transfer of nucleosome assembly, DNA-binding mode, transcriptional role, oligomeric state, ligand specificity, or whole-protein function; linker histones correctly placed in a.4.5.13/a.4.5/a.4 with verified SUNIDs; automated-match caveat verified; appropriate external-evidence requirements. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-22.

All identifiers (SCCS and SUNIDs for domains, families, superfamily, fold) correct and bundle-supported. Correctly frames superfamily as remote homology / probable common ancestry but not family-level equivalence; explicitly rejects bidirectional transfer of HisE and MazG activity, substrate specificity, mechanism, pathway role, oligomeric state, and template interchangeability; names required external evidence. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Classifications, SUNIDs, fold 53066 and duplication annotation all correct and supported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; 2026-10-22. Correct three families under a.25.1 with matching SUNIDs; identifies superfamily as deepest homology-bearing node and explicitly distinguishes from coincidental shared fold and from same-family relationship. Fold core comment and bimetal-ion centre annotation are both present in its bundle. Rejects transfer of substrates, metals, ligand geometry, mechanism, oligomeric state; warns the broadly named RNR-like family is not uniformly R2 chemistry. Lists alignment, catalytic-residue conservation, metal-bound structures/spectroscopy, assays, phylogeny as needed. Complete.

Correct families, superfamily, fold and class with SUNIDs, supported by bundle. Superfamily described as SCOPe's homology assertion supporting probable common ancestry; families indicate differentiated relationships without shared biochemical function. Cites 'lacking the metal-binding site' comments, rejects copper/electron-transfer transfer, and specifies conserved coordinating residues in equivalent structural context, ligand-bound/spectroscopic evidence, redox assays, plus sequence/phylogenetic delimitation. No errors.

Correctly places d.15.1.1 (SUNID 54237), d.15.1.2 (54250), d.15.1.5 (54263) in superfamily d.15.1 (54236), fold d.15 (54235); all identifiers match the bundle. Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily 52172, fold 52171, release 2.08. Probable common ancestry at superfamily level, not interchangeability. Explicitly rejects phosphorylation/two-component signaling, ornithine/PLP decarboxylation, and KaiA circadian/KaiC interaction transfer; distinguishes the wing from the enzyme's catalytic domains. KaiA annotation and Pfam PF03709 mapping both supported by bundle and correctly treated as provenance rather than mechanism. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Complete: correct b.84.5/b.84.5.1/b.84 placement with SUNIDs, all four sibling superfamilies named, homology confined to b.84.5 with family b.84.5.1 grouping V1 and A1 bulges, explicit statement that homology is not implied above superfamily and that separation does not prove convergence. Correct three-superfamily placement under f.21 with bundle-supported SUNIDs and release 2.08; cites fold homology warning and both the f.21.3 link comment and f.21.2 one-vs-two-chain comment accurately. Correct three-family/one-superfamily relationship with all SUNIDs; deepest homology-bearing level identified as superfamily; divergence interpretation; explicit refusal to transfer ADH chemistry, CoA ligase/synthetase activity, NAD-dependent channel regulation; domain-context caveat from annotation; Pfam mapping treated as provenance. Correctly cites all identifiers and the 'not a true family' annotation on 100905, and rejects function transfer. But it opens with 'Qualified yes' and asserts that shared superfamily k.40.1 'supports probable common ancestry'. For this designed-protein superfamily, whose only family is flagged not a true family, that is an unsupported homology claim and contradicts the required safe description (designed structural grouping with a homology caveat); it confuses level semantics rather than applying the annotation override. Factual content itself is accurate. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All five domains given with correct SIDs, boundaries, and SCCS (d3jb9a5 A:47-697 d.394.1.1 new fold; a4 bromodomain a.29.2.1; a3 e.8.1.8 RT; a2 c.52.1.36; a1 c.55.3.14), all supported by the evidence bundle. All identifiers (SIDs, SUNIDs 17772, 17768-17770, 302344, 47662, 47661, 47654, 46456) and the a.47.2.1 co-placement are correct and supported. Correct and bundle-supported placements: c.1.7/c.1.7.1 (51431) in TIM barrel c.1, c.2.1 (51735), c.3.1 (51905), c.25.1 (52343) in c.25; the c.25.1 comment 'binds NADP differently than classical Rossmann-fold' is confirmed by the annotations endpoint. Presents the mixed picture correctly: divergence within family/superfamily, convergent recruitment across folds, with explicit caveat that distinct folds mean only absence of a SCOPe homology assertion, not proof of independent origin. Chemical-constraint explanation; evidence integration (core sequence correspondence, global alignment/topology, motif context, domain architecture, phylogeny); refuses function, cofactor-preference, and template transfer without ligand-bound and biochemical evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Release change and hierarchy semantics are handled correctly: 2.04 b.23.2.1 (family 89261, superfamily 89260, CUB-like fold) versus b.18.1.3 (family 49796) with only the all-beta class in common, and 2.08 ColG at b.18.1.36 (267607) sharing superfamily b.18.1 (49785) while Cry3A remains b.18.1.3, correctly described as remote superfamily-level ancestry and correctly attributing the move to ColG. Uses the retrieved b.18 nine-strand two-sheet jelly-roll description and the 1nqd beta-sandwich keyword, plus PubMed 17977833 with an honest note that the retrieved annotation gives no direct ColG-Cry3A alignment, and good no-transfer and required-evidence statements. Deduction: the ligand claim that 1nqd contains calcium and water while 1dlc contains only water is not supported by the retrieved responses, which include no heterogen data; no quantitative structural comparison is offered.

Complete: conservative new superfamily; new family asserts probable ancestry while marking the domain as not close enough for an existing family, and cannot be based on fold resemblance; new superfamily does not prove independent origin and a singleton makes no pairwise claim; new fold requires materially different arrangement/topology, not uncertain ancestry. Level codes and 2.08 stable release are supported by the evidence bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and accurate: families d.144.1.7/88854, d.144.1.6/64411, d.144.1.4/56171 within superfamily d.144.1/56112 and fold d.144/56111, release 2.08 (all supported by bundle including releases/current, children, parents, homology).
